exam.title: Designing and Building Integrated AI Agent Solutions in Copilot Studio
exam.study_prerequisites: Advanced Copilot Studio building plus Power Fx, Dataverse, Power Platform environments and solutions, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Foundry, Adaptive Cards, RAG, MCP, A2A, prompt engineering, REST APIs, connectors, identity, governance, evaluation, telemetry, and ALM experience.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Integrate and extend agents in Copilot Studio

review.notes: Every subobjective on the official page last updated April 21, 2026 is mapped to an agent object, integration boundary, identity/governance decision, test, signal, or recovery path. Three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 36 original checks cover the current three-harness Copilot Studio crosswalk, architecture, identity and zoned governance, flows/HITL, topics/Power Fx/Adaptive Cards, prompts, variables, enterprise knowledge, connectors/REST/MCP/computer use, connected agents, evaluation, telemetry, solutions, and pipelines. All 33 cited URLs are cataloged: 31 reachable and two Udemy pages access-blocked. The September 7 update replaces the obsolete two-experience model while preserving the structured topic skills tested by the blueprint.

findings.title: Human stage can be bypassed by default decision routes
findings.evidence: Rejected stage can end before human review; import/sharing require recreation.

findings.evidence: Parallel custom topics share fifteen-snippet limit.
findings.recommendation: Add authorized/ranked result example and schema context.
findings.resolution: Add authorized/ranked result example and schema context.

findings.title: Card rendering and repeat submission differ by host
findings.evidence: Teams/live chat 1.5; Web Chat 1.6 without Action.Execute; old submit remains usable.
findings.recommendation: Add host matrix and server-side operation/version validation.
findings.resolution: Add host matrix and server-side operation/version validation.

findings.title: Human supervision is probabilistic
findings.evidence: May miss pauses; no reviewers can cause failed session.
findings.recommendation: Separate enforced gate and computer-use intended-use limits.
findings.resolution: Separate enforced gate and computer-use intended-use limits.

findings.title: Current Foundry defaults lack required connector protocol
findings.evidence: Activity must be enabled with REST/SDK; portal display not decisive.
findings.recommendation: Add distinct 400 protocol versus older-version failure diagnosis.
findings.resolution: Add distinct 400 protocol versus older-version failure diagnosis.

findings.title: Current Fabric tool has distinct harness and access model
findings.evidence: GitHub harness tool Maker mode exposes maker-accessible data.
findings.recommendation: Scope procedure and test caller/maker identity independently.
findings.resolution: Scope procedure and test caller/maker identity independently.

findings.title: Managed model choices do not determine BYO support
findings.evidence: BYO needs chat completions and excludes GPT-5-and-later.

findings.title: Evaluation now includes safety/custom methods
findings.evidence: Previous blanket no-safety statement is obsolete.
findings.recommendation: Replace with bounded method support and calibrated refusal/custom grading.
findings.resolution: Replace with bounded method support and calibrated refusal/custom grading.

findings.title: Pass rates can omit useful release evidence
findings.evidence: Invalid/errors, latency and retained results require separate interpretation.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit worksheet metrics, latency gate and export deadline.
findings.resolution: Add explicit worksheet metrics, latency gate and export deadline.

findings.title: Zero traces do not prove no activity
findings.evidence: Export delay, unsupported configs, event omissions and data loss.
findings.recommendation: Add tables, identity/scope, delay and audit limitation.
findings.resolution: Add tables, identity/scope, delay and audit limitation.

findings.title: Entitlement does not establish throughput
findings.evidence: Peak rate and downstream scopes differ from total credits.
findings.recommendation: Add pilot extrapolation example and measured-evidence requirement.
findings.resolution: Add pilot extrapolation example and measured-evidence requirement.
